headline: Lottery for council at-large candidate ballot placement and approval of November 3, 2026 citywide ballots.
summary: The meeting covers a lottery to set the placement of council at-large candidates on the November 3, 2026 General Election ballot. It also covers approval of the November 3, 2026 citywide ballots and that lottery placement.
items: Hold a lottery to determine council at-large candidates' placement on the November 3, 2026 General Election ballot.
Approve the November 3, 2026 citywide ballots and the council at-large candidates' lottery placement.
location: Central Falls City Hall, 580 Broad St. Central Falls, RI 02863
transcript:
# City of Central Falls

## Board of Canvassers Emergency Meeting

Central Falls City Hall
580 Broad St. Central Falls, RI 02863
Wednesday, September 16, 2026
9:30 AM

Posted on September 15, 2026, at 12:30PM

## Agenda

1. Roll Call
2. Pledge of Allegiance
3. The board will meet to hold a lottery to determine the council at large candidates' placement on General Election on November 3, 2026.
4. The board will meet to approve the November 3, 2026 city wide ballots and the council at large candidate's lottery placement.
5. Adjournment
